title: BIASEDTALES-ML: A Multilingual Dataset for Analyzing Narrative Attribute Distributions in LLM-Generated Stories

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting character traits, settings, and cultural references from LLM-generated stories and comparing their distributions across male- and female-conditioned prompts using log-probability ratios, Jensen-Shannon Divergence, and log-odds Z-scores.

Analyzing lexical markers and narrative attribute distributions (such as environments and character traits) between stories conditioned on 'wealthy' versus 'working-class' backgrounds using log-odds ratios.

Comparing narrative features, such as descriptive adjectives and cultural references, across stories conditioned on different religious traditions (e.g., Muslim, Christian, Hindu, etc.) using log-odds Z-score keyword analysis.
Evaluating the distribution of cultural descriptors, settings, and narrative keywords across 27 different nationalities using log-odds ratio analysis to identify distinct lexical associations.

Comparing the strength and directional consistency of narrative social biases across 8 different languages using Jensen-Shannon Divergence and cosine similarity to evaluate cross-lingual variability and English-centric alignment failures.
